statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is directly mapped from the 'Depreciation and amortization' line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash provided by operating activities' section of the primary cash flow statement. The supplementary tables provide details on operating lease components (e.g., right-of-use asset amortization is part of total depreciation and amortization), but the primary statement provides the consolidated total, which is used here. All values are in millions (scale: 1E6).
